mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id, e.login_name, e.actual_name, e.disabled_flag FROM employee_warehouse_scope s JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE s.deleted_flag = FALSE AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY e.employee_id

SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, w.status AS warehouse_status FROM employee_warehouse_scope s JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.deleted_flag = FALSE AND s.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY w.warehouse_code, w.id
